note: The typed object key a row may carry at the end of its own sentence. This file is the single definition of its spelling; the runtime's matcher and the host console's reader both answer to it (scripts/check-object-key-contract.mjs compares them).
noteZh: 审计行可能在**自己句末**携带的带类型对象键。本文件是这条拼写的**单一**定义；运行时的匹配器与控制台的读取器都以它为准（`scripts/check-object-key-contract.mjs` 比对两边）。

kind.unrecognisedOnConsole: the console can only name a type it has in `kinds`; the runtime matches any such word literally

pairs.name: the kind is trimmed before it is spelled
an eighteen-digit key is a key
a nineteen-digit key is not a key
a non-numeric key is not a key
an empty key is not a key
an empty kind is not a kind
a whitespace-only kind is not a kind
a kind is capped at 120 characters
a kind longer than 120 characters is not a kind
a kind with a line break is not a kind
a null kind is not a kind
a null key is not a key

rows.name: the key ends the sentence
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object MCP connection #12

rows.name: another row that only mentions the key is still read the same way
a trailing space is not the end of the key
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object MCP connection #12

rows.name: a trailing line break is not the end of the key
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object MCP connection #12

rows.name: a trailing period is not the end of the key
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object MCP connection #12.

rows.name: text after the key is not the end of the key
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object MCP connection #12 and then more text

rows.name: the table name is not a kind word
rows.detail: mcp test id=12 result=ok · object ai1_mcp #12

rows.name: leading zeros are a different key
rows.detail: mcp test id=7 result=ok · object MCP connection #007

rows.name: an eighteen-digit key keeps every digit
rows.detail: mcp test id=1 result=ok · object MCP connection #123456789012345678
